text.p: HARARE, July 18 Reuter) - These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A regional early warning unit says southern Africa may suffer poor harvests next year because global climate trends point to a possibility of poor rains during the 1997/98 (November-April) crop season.

- The central Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe has forwarded to the government Z$1 billion as profit from the state Gold and Foreign Adjustments Account in the year ended in June, up from Z$700 million profit accrued last year.

- Top officials from President Robert Mugabe's ruling ZANU-PF party will address former guerrillas who fought in Zimbabwe's independence war who are protesting and demonstrating over the months against the government's suspension of a war victims' compensation fund.
- President Mugabe said on Thursday his government was working on a programme that would transform Zimbabwe's local languages into viable tools of development.
